scope: Actual compiled Chromium synthetic rendered UI, three states at 390x844, 768x1024, 1024x768; full-page raster heights 942, 1039, 775. Finite visual acceptance only.

SOURCE_IDENTITY.binding: Manifest-declared exact source identity; all 27 raster/structure/crop SHA-256 values independently verified. Source implementation intentionally not read.

READABLE_VIEWS.method: Every native PNG and all nine provided 4x crop sheets opened and emitted through view_image. All 54 crop cells independently reproduced in memory from source pixels and compared byte-for-byte.

STRUCTURAL_RECORDS.method: All nine complete neutral records read. All 384 containment booleans independently recomputed from asset and container rectangles.

EDGE_GATES.method: Per-instance LEFT/RIGHT/TOP/BOTTOM ledger below. Intentionally covered assets resolved as modal occlusion, never claimed to have visible complete contours. Exposed profiles and utilities checked directly; corresponding picker views show underlying artwork.

APPLICATION_BINDING: WatchNest profile picker, parent PIN handoff and wrong-PIN states. Dimensions bind to supplied viewport and document records. Synthetic Chromium only.

HUMAN_GATES.alignment: PASS: card columns/rows, avatar carriers and names line up at each width; modal title, copy, PIN and Cancel share the central axis.
HUMAN_GATES.optical_centering: PASS: distinct bird, cat, bear and rocket silhouettes sit comfortably inside round carriers; modal rocket and logomark have clear margins.
HUMAN_GATES.spacing_rhythm: PASS: repeatable card padding, row/column gaps, title-to-copy and field-to-action spacing; error block adds height without crowding.
HUMAN_GATES.grouping: PASS: each name, avatar and status reads as one profile; Parent Mode remains a secondary action; error stays inside its PIN dialog.
HUMAN_GATES.hierarchy: PASS: Who’s watching leads picker; Open Eli’s library leads dialog; PIN field is conspicuous; current Selected profile differs in words and color.
HUMAN_GATES.crop_story: PASS: no active artwork has an incomplete contour; modal covers background intentionally. Full-page rasters include content below the viewport.
HUMAN_GATES.contrast: PASS by visual inspection: primary and supporting foreground copy is legible, focus ring distinct, wrong-PIN message clear; inactive backdrop is deliberately dim. No numeric WCAG claim.
HUMAN_GATES.visible_facts: PASS: four named profiles; Benny visibly selected; others show Parent handoff. Dialog asks parent for four-digit PIN, names Eli, states time limits are unchanged; error says Parent PIN is not correct. These are visible statements, not proof of enforcement.
HUMAN_GATES.gestalt: PASS: cohesive ink, lavender and peach palette; restrained family-friendly avatars; calm premium composition and clear parent/child handoff purpose.

limits: No physical iPad, authenticated hosted session, backend authorization, media playback, keyboard behavior or real-device usability claim.

Screenshots are full-page rasters: 390 layouts exceed viewport by 98px, 768 layouts by 15px and 1024 layouts by 7px. This is not horizontal clipping; below-viewport content is not asserted visible without scroll.

Opaque dialog intentionally covers some background assets, notably A03/A05 at 390; V04 A05 crop includes PIN border; V07/V09 A05 shows dialog surface; V09 A09 is partly covered. These crop contents do not establish broken underlying icon artwork.
No exact Golden/reference raster supplied; evaluated against minimal supplied product/brand context and current visual protocol.
Static pixels cannot prove the truth of visible protection/time-limit statements or functional PIN rejection.

blind_jury_return_contract.why: Controller explicitly requested one member of a five-person final independent jury; no defect or repair history sought.
blind_jury_return_contract.convergence_reviewers_used: Not provided; not inspected to preserve independence.
blind_jury_return_contract.jury_round_count: One review round by this juror; broader run count not supplied.
blind_jury_return_contract.material_progress_status: Not assessed: no prior artifact consumed.
blind_jury_return_contract.golden_reused_or_rebuilt: No Golden supplied; neither rebuilt nor requalified.
